column1: # Cards added to EDS (the first 100 of missing.txt). One row per card:
#   id       new card ID (821..920, after the 820 original IDs; every per-card table is indexed by it)
#   number   card number (gCardIdToNumber / gCardNumberToId; free numbers below 1210, so Card Trading
#            lists them, and not used by any card, effect key or code check)
#   passcode YGOPRODeck card id = the 8-digit password, which also selects its data and cropped art
#   name     the card's name (also gives its CARD_ constant in include/constants/cards.h)
#   [game_name]  the name shown in the game when the real one is too long: the Deck Edit list rows hold 41
#            characters (the original game shortens "Winged Dragon,Guardian of the Fortress #1" the same way)
# tools/newcards.py fetch downloads the stats, text and art into assets/new_cards/ (never committed).
